lb_complex_dt <- function(tbl, cap, rownames = FALSE){
    datatable(
        tbl,
        caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
            cap,
            style = "text-align: left;"
        ),
        options = list(
            dom = "tflipr",  # Available options: tflipr
            columnDefs = list(list(className = 'dt-left', targets = "_all")),  # Align all columns left
            pageLength = 10,  # Show all results
            scrollCollapse = TRUE,  # Removes whitespace when table is small
            scrollY = "100%",  # Sets max height of table before scrollbar is added
            scrollX = TRUE,  # Enable horizontal scrolling when too wide
            sScrollX = "100%",  # Stops last column title being cut off
            initComplete = JS(  # Set font
                "function(settings, json) {",
                "$('body').css({'font-family': 'Calibri'});",
                "}"
            )
        ),
        rownames = rownames,
        height = "100%",  # Seems to work in tandem with scrollCollapse
        width = "100%",  # Fills width when viewed in RStudio viewer
        class = "stripe hover row-border order-column compact nowrap"
    )
}

PC correlations


Code
gclen_summary <- dge_list$counts %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    pivot_longer(
        cols = colnames(dge_list),
        names_to = "sample",
        values_to = "counts"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
        counts > 0
    ) %>%
    left_join(
        gene_gclen
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
        ends_with("id"), sample, counts, gc_content, length
    ) %>%
    split(f = .$sample) %>%
    lapply(
        function(x){
            DataFrame(
                gc = Rle(x$gc_content, x$counts),
                logLen = Rle(log10(x$length), x$counts)
            )
        }
    ) %>%
    vapply(function(x){
        c(mean(x$gc), sd(x$gc), mean(x$logLen), sd(x$logLen))
    }, numeric(4)
    ) %>%
    t() %>%
    set_colnames(
        c("mn_gc", "sd_gc", "mn_logLen", "sd_logLen")
    ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
    as_tibble()




Code

    dplyr::select(
        PC1, PC2, PC3,
        mean_gc = mn_gc,

title: PKTu
text:
psen1 genotype

Design
The design matrix was defined containing an intercept representing baseline expression in wildtype samples. The remaining two columns represent the presence of either the EofAD or fAI mutant alleles.


Code
design_psen1 <- model.matrix(~geno_psen1, data = dge_list$samples) %>%
    set_colnames(str_remove(colnames(.), "geno_psen1"))




Code
pheatmap(
    design_psen1[meta$sample,],
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    color = c("white", "grey50"),
    annotation_row = dge_list$samples["geno_psen1"],
    annotation_colors = list(group = pal_group),
    angle_col = "315",
    legend = FALSE
)





Visualisation of the design matrix






Model fitting


Code
fit_psen1 <- estimateDisp(dge_list, design_psen1) %>%
    glmQLFit()
tt_psen1 <- colnames(design_psen1)[2:3] %>%
    sapply(function(x){
        glmQLFTest(fit_psen1, coef = x) %>%
            topTags(n = Inf) %>%
            .[["table"]] %>%
            as_tibble() %>%
            arrange(PValue) %>%
            dplyr::select(
                gene_id, gene_name, logFC, logCPM, PValue, FDR, everything()
            ) %>%
            mutate(
                bonfP = p.adjust(PValue, "bonf"),
                DE = ifelse(FDR < 0.05, TRUE, FALSE),
                DE_cat = case_when(
                    logFC <= 0 & DE ~ "Downregulated",
                    logFC >= 0 & DE ~ "Upregulated",
                    !DE ~ "Non-siginificant"
                ),
                coef = x,
                label = glue("<b style='color:{pal_group[coef]}'>{coef}</b>"),
            )
    }, simplify = FALSE)

lb_complex_dt <- function(tbl, cap, rownames = FALSE){
    datatable(
        tbl,
        caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
            cap,
            style = "text-align: left;"
        ),
        options = list(
            dom = "tflipr",  # Available options: tflipr
            columnDefs = list(list(className = 'dt-left', targets = "_all")),  # Align all columns left
            pageLength = 10,  # Show all results
            scrollCollapse = TRUE,  # Removes whitespace when table is small
            scrollY = "100%",  # Sets max height of table before scrollbar is added
            scrollX = TRUE,  # Enable horizontal scrolling when too wide
            sScrollX = "100%",  # Stops last column title being cut off
            initComplete = JS(  # Set font
                "function(settings, json) {",
                "$('body').css({'font-family': 'Calibri'});",
                "}"
            )
        ),
        rownames = rownames,
        height = "100%",  # Seems to work in tandem with scrollCollapse
        width = "100%",  # Fills width when viewed in RStudio viewer
        class = "stripe hover row-border order-column compact nowrap"
    )
}

gclen_summary <- dge_list$counts %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    pivot_longer(
        cols = colnames(dge_list),
        names_to = "sample",
        values_to = "counts"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
        counts > 0
    ) %>%
    left_join(
        gene_gclen
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
        ends_with("id"), sample, counts, gc_content, length
    ) %>%
    split(f = .$sample) %>%
    lapply(
        function(x){
            DataFrame(
                gc = Rle(x$gc_content, x$counts),
                logLen = Rle(log10(x$length), x$counts)
            )
        }
    ) %>%
    vapply(function(x){
        c(mean(x$gc), sd(x$gc), mean(x$logLen), sd(x$logLen))
    }, numeric(4)
    ) %>%
    t() %>%
    set_colnames(
        c("mn_gc", "sd_gc", "mn_logLen", "sd_logLen")
    ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
    as_tibble()

Visualisation of the design matrix






Model fitting


Code
fit_psen1 <- estimateDisp(dge_list, design_psen1) %>%
    glmQLFit()
tt_psen1 <- colnames(design_psen1)[2:3] %>%
    sapply(function(x){
        glmQLFTest(fit_psen1, coef = x) %>%
            topTags(n = Inf) %>%
            .[["table"]] %>%
            as_tibble() %>%
            arrange(PValue) %>%
            dplyr::select(
                gene_id, gene_name, logFC, logCPM, PValue, FDR, everything()
            ) %>%
            mutate(
                bonfP = p.adjust(PValue, "bonf"),
                DE = ifelse(FDR < 0.05, TRUE, FALSE),
                DE_cat = case_when(
                    logFC <= 0 & DE ~ "Downregulated",
                    logFC >= 0 & DE ~ "Upregulated",
                    !DE ~ "Non-siginificant"
                ),
                coef = x,
                label = glue("<b style='color:{pal_group[coef]}'>{coef}</b>"),
            )
    }, simplify = FALSE)

fqc_raw <- list.files(
    path = here("smk-de/results/raw_data/FastQC"),
    pattern = "zip",
    full.names = TRUE
)
## Fix raw FQC zip file structure caused by workflow renaming of FQC files
## Otherwise we encounter a bug in ngsReports
fqc_raw %>%
    lapply(\(x){
        contents <- unzip(x, list = TRUE)
        old_dir <- str_remove(contents$Name[1], "/$")
        new_dir <- str_remove(basename(x), ".zip$")
        if (old_dir != new_dir) {
            unzip(x)
            file.remove(x)
            system(paste('mv', old_dir, new_dir))
            files_to_zip <- list.files(here(old_dir), full.names = TRUE)
            zip(x, new_dir)
            unlink(new_dir, recursive = TRUE)
        }
    })
fqc_raw <- fqc_raw %>%
    FastqcDataList()
## Rename fqc_raw to names used by workflow
sample_rename <- read_tsv(here("smk-de/config/units.tsv")) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c("fq1", "fq2"), values_to = "fq") %>%
    dplyr::select(new = sample, old = fq) %>%
    mutate(
        old = basename(old),
        new = ifelse(
            str_detect(old, "_R1_001.fastq.gz$"),
            paste0(new, "_1_R1.fastq.gz"),
            paste0(new, "_1_R2.fastq.gz")
        )
    )
fqName(fqc_raw) <- vapply(fqName(fqc_raw), \(x){
    sample_rename$new[sample_rename$old == x]
}, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
## Subset for samples we want to analyse
keep_raw <- vapply(fqName(fqc_raw), \(x){
    str_remove(x, "_1_R(1|2).fastq.gz") %in% meta$sample
}, logical(1))
fqc_raw <- fqc_raw[keep_raw]
